class.name: DialogueSpeakers
class.brief_description: The speakers of a game, found by their id.

method.name: add_speaker
method.description: Adds [param speaker] at the end of [member speakers]. Fails if it is [code]null[/code] or already in the list.

method.name: get_ids
method.description: Returns the ids of the speakers as written, in list order, each once (ignoring case), without empty ids. The Inspector suggests them for speaker properties.

method.name: get_speaker
method.description: Returns the first speaker whose id matches [param id] ignoring case ([code]"ANNA"[/code] finds [code]anna[/code]), or [code]null[/code] if there is none or [param id] is empty.

method.name: get_translatable_strings
method.description: Returns the entries for POT generation: one per speaker, [code][name, "speaker", "", "Speaker name (id)"][/code], where the name is [member DialogueSpeaker.display_name] or the id if it is empty. The context [code]"speaker"[/code] is the one [method DialogueSpeaker.get_translated_name] translates with. The editor uses it for [DialogueSpeakers] files added to the POT generation list ([b]Project Settings > Localization > POT Generation[/b]).

method.name: has_speaker
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a speaker has the id [param id], ignoring case.

method.name: remove_speaker
method.description: Removes the first speaker with the id [param id] (ignoring case). Does nothing if there is none.

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns one message per problem: an empty slot, a speaker without an id, an id with [code],[/code] or [code]:[/code] (they separate the Inspector's suggestions), or an id used by two speakers (ignoring case). Returns an empty array if the list is valid. Segments with unknown speaker ids are reported by [method Subtitle.validate] ([member SubtitleValidation.unknown_speaker_segments]).

members.member: The speakers. The ids should be unique: [method get_speaker] returns the first match.
